flavor2: Minos is a hard man to find. The scraps of information you do manage to uncover inevitably lead to a dead end: a missing fisherman, a burned down temple, a murdered philosopher. It doesn't help that the Minoans are not as forthcoming as you would like. It seems the king held the island in too tight a grip, and there are many who would prefer him to remain missing.
A lesser crew would give up on this fruitless search. But not you. Even the absence of clues is in itself a clue. Someone has been covering their tracks.

There's talk of foreigners supposedly looking for the same prize you're after. Not far from your current position, atop a mount on an artificial island, stands an unfinished Cretan wonder known to some as the City of the Bull. Construction halted when the Great Mourning began--yet now there are rumors of foreign ships coming and going under the cover of night.
It might be prudent to pay it a visit

Minos is gone and with him, the true line of Minoan rulers seemingly ends. Your contract with the Minoan Dynasty cannot be fulfilled.

Ironically, the Sepulcher Acropolis housed the Daedalus Vault, the very place you've risked your neck for. With the parts found within, Alkabiades mends the Argo. You can finally leave this accursed island behind.
Yet you remain. For during your journey you've learned that mere survival is not enough. This world desperately needs hope heroes--and you will provide both. This is your purpose.

cards.name: Baselios
cards.flavor: A spirited strategist and irrepressible optimist, Baseleos is undaunted by the harsh and challenging world of post-Eschaton Hellas. Ready to take on the towering responsibilities of an Argonaut, he is determined to let no foe stand in the way of his pursuit of a better tomorrow

cards.name: Odys Zero
cards.flavor: Odys Zero was the last to wake up of the original four. He's impulsive, nonchalant and overly brave (or stupid). Many call him 'the Nevercaptain', for he wanted to lead the Argonauts, only for that honor to fall to Circegard. Lately, Odys Zero sleeps uneasily. Terrible dreams haunt him. Visions of the Zero Point Entity and its arrival in the skies above Alexandria. The blinding flash that sears the disappearing city skyline deep into his retinas. Those dreams are becoming more intense. A voice accompanies them now. It whispers: "Follow the light of Pharos."

cards.name: Circegard
cards.flavor: Circegard does not remember how she lost an eye. Strangely, she does not harbor resentment... as if she deserved it. Calm and collected, she was anointed by the outcast council to lead the Argo after her stand against the Hermesian Pursuer. Many feel she lacks the empathy to lead the crew, while others argue that a cold calculated approach is exactly what the Argo needs in these dark times. As for Circegard, she spends more and more time junctioning with her Titan. In its mind's eye she found a... spark

cards.name: Phenelope
cards.flavor: Aloof Phenelope is as deadly, as she is beautiful. With a natural affinity for all things machina, she shares her time between the battlefield and the Last Academy, where she helps decipher the phos scriptures. Her fair complexion and gentle features betray a foreign heritage. Some even say she resembles the Silver People, though only the Atlanteans could verify these bold claims -- and they sleep in their watery graves

cards.name: Telebacchus
cards.flavor: The always jovial Telebacchus is the heart of the crew and serves as an intermediary between the 'mere mortals' and the 'awakened' Argonauts. He's also the only one who truly enjoys junctioning with his Titan, which he finds enlightening and uplifting

cards.name: Herakleides
cards.flavor: Herakleides is a bit lost. When he looks into his reflection, he sees an old man, his stories done and told, his debt for the world paid in full, with interest. That is what he sees. What he remembers is... nothing. He's like a young boy, eager and anxious to be tested on the stage of Hellas

cards.name: Olympia
cards.flavor: Olympia is a kind and gentle soul, out of place in this world of darkness and violence. Olympia herself knows that too -- that is why she is fighting so hard, to create a better, more beautiful world, if not for her, then for those who come after

cards.name: Leocules
cards.flavor: Leocules doesn't know who he was and he doesn't care a bit. His body remembers: the hardships and the struggles of a life fought and won. The violence. He treats his awakening from the Mausoleum as an opportunity: to become a gentler, more empathetic man, at peace with himself

cards.name: Raz
cards.flavor: Raz knows she hails from the Forbidden East, where an ancient Empire is said to have risen to immense power and wealth. She finds she has little in common with those notions, as the only thing she seeks is knowledge

cards.name: Fisher
cards.flavor: Fisher is told she looks cold and calculating. She likes it that way, it makes her interactions with the world that much easier. She's pragmatic and driven, though she knows, maybe better than anyone else, that the Argo's mission is bigger than any single ambition. She will make sure it reaches its destination, whatever it is
